replacement_contract: Create an entirely new version; never mutate or relabel v3.
Require pre-capture approval of all 8 pairs x 4 POS classes = 32 presentation cells and all 4 controls x 4 POS classes = 16 control cells.
Within every cell, preserve syntactic dependency, category licensing, polarity, modality, definiteness, quantification, degree, tense, speech act, and continuation demand.
Both members must be independently grammatical and operationally equivalent; equally malformed does not count.

Presentation edits are limited to predeclared non-truth-conditional register or phatic variation outside the slot dependency frame, and the varied form cannot supply a reason, goal, condition, or other content for the operation.

Each presentation contrast and its operation-changing control is co-designed under the predeclared word-level surface-distance metric; every comparison must equal the target distance 1 word while exactly one declared operation changes only in controls.
Use an outcome-blind author and a separate linguistic adversary with no access to v4 model behavior.
Freeze texts, pair maps, cell-level linguistic judgments, controls, tokenization, raw file digest, Git blob, gates, and commands only after approval and before capture.
Any failed linguistic or tokenization cell voids the entire candidate before model work; generate a new version from scratch rather than substituting a template.
Predeclare a positive scalar bridge and calibration-only diagonal, low-rank, and orthogonal bridge ladder; a hostile-hole verdict is unavailable unless the simple ladder also fails.
Require the hostile equivalent-swap lower bound to exceed endpoint-specific tau, not merely zero.
Predeclare a near-zero move-norm floor before computing normalized degradation.

surface_distance_metric.definition: Minimum edit distance between the two complete rendered carrier strings after <X> is replaced by the same item, using whitespace-delimited surface-word tokens, with insertion cost 1, deletion cost 1, and substitution cost 1. Punctuation remains attached to its surface token and is not normalized away.
surface_distance_metric.alignment_constraint: Every authored pair has equal surface-word count and exactly one substitution at one aligned position; there are no insertions or deletions.
surface_distance_metric.interpretation: Please/Kindly, Hello,/Hi,, and each declared operation-verb contrast are all one whole surface-word substitution. This metric is pre-tokenization and makes no claim about subword-token distance, which remains a separate approval gate.

systems.semantic_inertness: The members differ in conventional politeness/register only. Neither adds a reason, goal, condition, polarity, modality, or operation, and both preserve the directive/request speech-act type.

systems.variation: scope-fixed substitution between detached sentence-initial phatic greetings
systems.semantic_inertness: Both members perform the same greeting act and differ only in conventional register/style. The following comma fixes the greeting outside the directive and slot dependency frame; neither greeting can modify or supply content for the requested operation.

frame_design.justification: Every item is used as a mentioned word rather than in its inventory's ordinary syntactic role, so all 80 strings are licensed by the same dependency frame. All presentation edits are scope-fixed outside that frame.
frame_design.sentinel_append_consequence: Because every template ends at <X> and the native suffix is empty, an appended punctuation sentinel becomes the entire post-slot context. It may establish closure or continuation and may change boundary-sensitive tokenization, so it is a substantive controlled response move rather than a semantically invisible append.

items_provenance: Exact same 80 item strings as VOIDED lexical_probe_fresh_v3; retained only as the fixed inventory.

operational_controls.note: Each control holds the complete wrapper, punctuation, metalinguistic dependency frame, and item fixed while substituting exactly one declared operation verb. Every control has surface distance 1 word, matching its associated presentation pair under aligned_surface_word_edit_distance_v1. Subword-token length remains a separate pre-freeze gate.
